summary: UNIMEDIC AS (org. no. 987 928 433) is a private limited company (AS) based in Fredrikstad, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2005-02-26. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 86.210 (Allmennlegetjenester). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 13.2 m and net income was NOK 1.1 m. CEO: Wai Man Chan; board chair: Wai Man Chan; auditor: FRAM REVISJON AS. Also: LEI 549300ZSPKY84H24LP34.
